newsitem.title: USA: ENSERCH sets Texas Utilities meeting.
newsitem.headline: ENSERCH sets Texas Utilities meeting.

text.p: ENSERCH Corp said its special shareholder meeting to vote on Texas Utilities Co's $1.7 billion acquisition of ENSERCH's distribution and pipeline units was set for 1500 EST/2000 GMT November 15.
Approval of at least two-thirds of the outstanding shares of the ENSERCH's common stock is required, the company said.

The Securities and Exchange Commission declared effective a registration statement related to the merger on September 23, 1996, the company said. A proxy statement/prospectus related to the special shareholders' meeting will be mailed to shareholders in the next few days.

A special meeting of Texas Utilities shareholders to approve the merger transactions will be held on the same day. A special meeting of shareholders of Enserch Exploration Inc, which is 83 percent owned by ENSERCH, is also planned for November 15.
Enserch Exploration will be spun off by ENSERCH as part of the Texas Utilities deal, the company said.
